value: A new read-only existing-run adapter API resolves official Requirements rule references only from the package-owned frozen bundled-v2 binding or its bounded saved-artifact-backed legacy-v1 continuation; selector, process cwd, and caller manifest values cannot retarget it; invalid authority blocks without mutation; existing pre-run stage_contract and public stage_request remain unchanged until Phase 3.

{"path":"tests/test_aidlc_official_bridge.py","role":"editable-proof","test_cases":["new existing-run adapter resolves a bundled-v2 frozen binding","future selector and process-cwd changes do not retarget the resolved rule set","only a categorically missing binding attempts bounded legacy-v1 continuation","altered incompatible unsafe and legacy-unauthorized state fails without fallback","required rule paths stay within the resolved pack and reject symlinks missing files and bad markers","existing pre-run stage_contract public stage_request and host-question behavior remain unchanged"],"fixtures":["temporary content-addressed bundled-v2 project pack and run binding","saved schema-v1 bridge activation and compatibility pack","selector pointing at a different future-run pack","temporary cwd outside the project","altered missing unsafe and marker-incomplete rule states"],"assertions":["all references derive from the package resolver result for the requested run","current.json process cwd and caller manifest values are irrelevant to the new API","legacy mode remains read-only and cannot authorize a new Full run","invalid state produces a categorical actionable failure without mutation or fallback","the current public route remains behaviorally unchanged for later Phase 3 migration"],"baseline":{"command":"python3 -m unittest tests.test_aidlc_official_bridge","outcome":"not-run","observed":"The existing suite covers the current official bridge Requirements route but does not yet contain tests for a separate frozen-resolution adapter API."}}
